sources.note: Main website (redirected from officeally.com). Lists five core products: Service Center, Practice Mate, EHR 24/7, EDI Clearinghouse, Insurance Discovery. 80,000+ healthcare organizations served, 250B+ claims value, 6,100+ payers, 1.4M+ NPIs.
Company established in 2000. Serves 80,000+ orgs from startup to Fortune 100. Offices in Brentwood TN, Salt Lake City UT, San Antonio TX, Vancouver WA. ~12 named executives.

ONC ACB certification page. CMS Certification ID 2025CUD8GVA660Z, live date 12/26/2024, EHR version 5.9.255. Links to Real World Testing plans/results, EHI export documentation, Cost and Considerations guide.

EHR 24/7 product page. Centralized dashboard for scheduling, charting, billing. Add-ons: Eligibility verification, Reminder Mate, OA-Rx (e-prescribing), Intake Pro, Updox Messaging, Statement Mailing. Built-in clearinghouse integration.
EHR 24/7 data sheet. Primarily a pricing/service agreement. $44.95/mo per provider. Eligibility transactions pricing. Limited technical feature details.

Pricing page for all products. Practice Mate: free with transactional fees. EHR 24/7: $44.95/mo/provider. Eligibility: $10/mo for first 100. EPCS: $100/yr. Updox messaging: $6/user/mo. Various enterprise and revenue recovery products with custom pricing.

EHR 24/7 support center. Reveals functional areas: patient management (adding/merging patients), clinical documentation (SOAP notes, templates, nurse notes), patient data (allergies, medications, immunizations, blood sugar logs, labs, radiology, referrals), admin (scheduling, audit logs, PHI disclosure), practice operations (pharmacy, labs, data import).
Knowledgebase landing page. High-level categories: Account Management, Claims, Product Questions, Technical Issues, Compliance. Limited EHR-specific breakdown at this level.

Patient Ally portal page (from search results). Free patient portal: view medical records, lab results, medications, immunizations; request appointments; send/receive messages; make payments; complete intake forms.

Third-party EHR review site. 4/5 stars, 8 reviews. Features: SOAP notes, e-prescribing, customizable templates, lab integration, Dragon dictation integration. Pros: affordable, simple. Cons: clunky interface, poor customer service, weak reporting, outdated appearance.
Software Advice profile (403 on fetch but search snippet confirmed features and pricing info).

Healthie glossary entry on Office Ally. Describes EHR for documenting encounters, storing patient info, ordering labs/radiology. PM for scheduling, billing, claims. Patient portal for 24/7 health info access. Also provides medical billing/coding services, claims processing, collections.

iFax overview of Office Ally EHR. Describes clinical charting, document management with SOAP notes, lab/HIE integration, claims processing via Service Center, Practice Mate PM integration. Add-ons: e-prescribing, reminders, Direct messaging, patient portal, telehealth.
Blog post about Capterra recognition. 4.6/5 overall rating on Capterra. Identified as high-performing for value.
